topic: How Different Organ Systems Work Together
key_concepts: Humans are made of organ systems that coordinate to perform specific functions.
The musculo-skeletal system provides support and enables body movement.
Cardiac and smooth muscles control involuntary actions, while skeletal muscles move bones
The skeletal system protects internal organs, supports the body, and produces blood cells.
The integumentary system covers the body, protects against microorganisms and temperature,
Skin has tough cells and keratin that protect underlying tissues from damage.
Digestion begins in the mouth with mechanical breakdown by cutting, tearing, and grinding.
Chemical digestion uses enzymes to break food into molecules; final digestion and nutrient
The respiratory system exchanges carbon dioxide and oxygen in the bloodstream.
Air moves through the nostrils, pharynx, trachea, bronchi, and lungs.
The circulatory system transports nutrients to cells and carries away cell wastes.
The nervous system serves as the body's control unit.
